Query computes C=gamma_R(R), finds normalized pair, applies gamma_R^-1=epsilon*tau^((19-j)mod19) to both, then group-replays with P. Allcanonicalization and transport charged.

Build these fresh only in this arm. Canonical key is the minimum unsigned19bit normal-coordinate x among cyclic left rotations j0..18, tiesleastj. For each anchored S store Frob^j endpoints and full sum C with this xkey, without sign normalization; deduplicate by normalized pair then C. Onquery, canonicalize x only; afterhit compute Rprime=Frob^j(R), require Rprime=C or -C, chooseepsilon accordingly, then return epsilon*Frob^((19-j)mod19) of stored endpoints. Reject mismatchedylift; infinity handled separately. Store no scalarlogs. No per-query y normalization on misses.
